decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting narratives regarding Pierre-Paul Boësnier de l'Orme's career. Document 1 (D1) explicitly states he held the position of 'Member of the South Australian House of Assembly' (D1S2) and previously served as a 'councillor in the Lyon City Council' (D1S6). Document 2 (D2), titled 'The Unassuming Statesman', asserts he assumed the position of 'vice president' (D2S3, D2S16) and held a 'senior role within the French Ministry of the Interior' (D2S13). Per the instruction to preserve distinct valid referents and complementary answers without resolving contradictions silently, all four positions mentioned in the source texts are included as they represent the claims found in the respective documents.
